hypothesis: Combining Bollinger Bands with RSI and ADX creates a robust mean-reversion strategy that filters out false signals in ranging markets by ensuring strong momentum and clear trend direction before entering trades

Mean reversion strategy using Bollinger Bands and RSI exploits momentum exhaustion at extreme levels, with ATR-based risk management ensuring volatility-adjusted position sizing and consistent risk-reward profiles across varying market conditions.

Reducing the RSI period from 15 to 14 increases sensitivity to short-term momentum shifts, while tightening the oversold/overbought thresholds from 25/75 to 30/70 reduces whipsaw in choppy markets. Extending take-profit to 3x ATR captures larger moves while maintaining 1.5x stop-loss for risk control.
